 Al Nassr FC vs Al Kholood Al Nassr FC Al Kholood Saudi Pro League C. Ronaldo Saudi Arabia Portugal Ronaldo leads Al-Nassr's squad
 Al-Nassr have named their starting line-up to face Al-Khaleej this Thursday evening in the twelfth round of the Saudi Roshn Pro League. The Global Club want three more points to keep the heat on leaders Al-Hilal.
 Ange Postecoglou's side lean on Portugal's Cristiano Ronaldo and Senegal's Sadio Mane up front, with Portugal's Joao Felix and Abdullah Al-Hamdan in support. Al-Khaleej, meanwhile, chase a positive result against a title contender.
 Read also: Jaissle settles it: what is Newcastle's stance on signing Ivan Toney? 
 Second in the Roshn League with 25 points from 10 matches, Al-Nassr arrive on the back of 8 wins and a single draw against one defeat. Al-Khaleej sit tenth on 12 points, picked up from 3 wins, 3 draws and 4 defeats.

 Al-Nassr changes from the Al-Faisaly clash
 Postecoglou has freshened up the side that beat Al-Faisaly 3-1 last time out. Angelo Gabriel comes in for Samu Costa, Ayman Yahya replaces Awad Aman, and Mohamed Simakan takes over from Abdulelah Al-Amri. These changes remain subject to matching the official line-up published by the club before being finalised.
 • Goalkeeper: Bento Matheus.
 • Defence: Nawaf Boushal, Mohamed Simakan, Inigo Martinez, Ayman Yahya.
 • Midfield: Abdullah Al-Khaibari, Angelo Gabriel, Abdullah Al-Hamdan, Joao Felix.
 • Attack: Cristiano Ronaldo, Sadio Mane.
